items.title: Checkout without an account
items.description: Let first-time shoppers pay without creating an account. Goal: sign-up-step drop-off from 38% to under 20% within 4 weeks of launch.

items.title: Support and safety for guest orders
items.description: Guest orders can be found, screened and returned like account orders.

items.title: Pay as a guest with email and delivery details
items.description: As a first-time shopper, I can pay without creating an account, so I can buy in one sitting.
acceptance_criteria: Given a shopper with no account at checkout, when they choose Continue as guest, then they can pay after entering only an email address and delivery details
Given a guest payment succeeds, then no account is created

items.title: Order confirmation email for guest orders
items.description: As a guest shopper, I get a confirmation email with a tracking link, so I know the order went through.
acceptance_criteria: Given a guest order is placed, then a confirmation email is sent to the address given within 5 minutes
The email contains a link that shows the order's tracking status without signing in

items.title: Offer an account after a guest order
items.description: As a guest shopper, I'm offered an account pre-filled from my order after paying, and I can decline.
acceptance_criteria: Given a guest order is confirmed, then the confirmation page offers to create an account with email and address pre-filled
Given the shopper declines, then no account is created and they aren't asked again for this order

items.title: Find guest orders by email in the admin tool
items.description: As a support agent, I can find a guest order from the shopper's email address.
acceptance_criteria: Given a guest order exists for an email address, when support searches that address in the admin tool, then the order is listed

items.title: Fraud score on guest orders
items.description: Guest orders go through fraud screening and show the same score as account orders.
acceptance_criteria: Given a guest order, then the admin order view shows a fraud score computed the same way as for account orders

items.title: Guest returns with order number and email
items.description: As a guest shopper, I can start a return with my order number and email.
acceptance_criteria: Given a delivered guest order, when the shopper enters the order number and the email used, then they can start a return
Given a mismatched order number and email, then no order details are shown
